description: Body of a catalog search. Phrasings are alternatives for one need, not separate searches.

limit.description: Most hits to return, at most 50.

query.description: One to 5 phrasings of the measure you need, such as ['mrr', 'monthly recurring revenue']. Send the user's words and the likely metric words together. A metric that matches any phrasing is returned.

status.description:
Only metrics with this review status. Omit to search both. Approved metrics rank above proposed ones with an equal match.

* `proposed` - proposed
* `approved` - approved
